attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster (systemd-managed) across node1/node2/node3 with application keys under /app/*, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped service, removed member from raft, wiped its data directory), then replaced it: registered a fresh member via `member add`, reconfigured node3's etcd unit with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started it. The new member joined with a distinct member ID, synced full application keyspace, and the cluster returned to 3/3 healthy. Completed mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirming a changed OS boot_id after each and full etcd cluster health/quorum/data recovery before moving to the next node.
